Bug_Title: Overrides should match their parent class methods in synchronization
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the 'Child' class where the overridden method 'foo' is not synchronized, even though the parent class 'Parent' method 'foo' is synchronized. This can lead to improper synchronization as callers rely on the thread-safety promised by the parent class.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the'showBug' method of the 'SynchronizationBugExample' class, which creates two threads that run the 'foo' method of the 'Child' class concurrently. Since the 'foo' method in 'Child' is not synchronized, it fails to maintain the synchronization contract of the 'foo' method in 'Parent', leading to potential race conditions and incorrect behavior.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results show that the test passed without any failures or exceptions, indicating that the presence of the bug was not confirmed through the test execution.
